security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown examples or checklists that describe unsafe MERN patterns for the reviewer to flag, not code executed by the skill. I confirmed the skill instructions to run local review commands and inspect git history for .env files as real operational risks that need user permission and secret redaction.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running tsc, find, xargs, grep, npm audit, or similar commands. Use read-only file inspection when command execution is not necessary.
When checking .env, key, certificate, or git history patterns, report only file paths and presence. Redact all secret values and avoid copying credentials into output.
Document that npm audit can contact external registries. Ask permission before running it in private or regulated projects.

remediation.issue: Executable examples mixed with review prose
remediation.suggestion: Label dangerous examples as non-executable reference snippets and separate them from commands the agent may actually run.

content.user_title: Review MERN Code with Security Focus
content.value_statement: MERN reviews can miss build, security, and architecture problems. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured checks and clear findings.
actual_capabilities: Checks build status, project documents, tests, file sizes, and dependencies before detailed review.
Reviews MERN security issues such as NoSQL injection, XSS, auth tokens, CORS, secrets, and rate limiting.
Uses React, Express, Node.js, MongoDB, security, and full-stack reference checklists when relevant.
Prioritizes findings into Critical, Important, and Suggestions with file locations and fix guidance.
Flags maintainability, performance, testing, and architecture issues such as god files, N+1 queries, sync I/O, and missing indexes.
limitations: It is guidance for an AI agent, not a standalone scanner.
It focuses on MERN projects and may not fit other technology stacks.
Some checks suggest local commands and should require user approval in untrusted repositories.
It can miss runtime-only issues without tests, deployment config, or production telemetry.

use_cases.title: Pre-Merge Feature Review
use_cases.description: Review changed MERN files for security, correctness, tests, and maintainability before a pull request is merged.

use_cases.title: Repository Health Audit
use_cases.description: Assess build status, large files, dependency risk, architecture shape, and test coverage across a MERN repository.

use_cases.title: Release Security Check
use_cases.description: Inspect authentication, CORS, token storage, secrets handling, file uploads, and database query risks before release.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Single File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one component, route, or model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this MERN file for correctness, security, maintainability, and test gaps. Use Critical, Important, and Suggestions sections.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed files in this MERN pull request. Start with build and test health, then focus on security and user-facing regressions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Repository
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a whole project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this MERN repository for project health, security, performance, testing, and architecture. Sample key files and report deployment blockers first.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Security and Architecture Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a release-focused review of this MERN app. Prioritize exploitable security issues, broken deployment signals, high-risk architecture, and missing tests.

output_examples.input: Review my Express authentication routes before release.
output: Project Health: build not checked, tests found for auth service, no deployment blocker noted.
Critical: missing rate limiting on login and register endpoints.
Important: token errors return inconsistent response shapes.
Verdict: needs fixes before release because authentication controls are incomplete.

output_examples.input: Audit this React and Node.js feature branch for merge readiness.
output: Scope: changed React screens, API routes, and related models.
Critical: no issue found in the reviewed authentication path.
Important: large list renders without virtualization and can block the UI.
Suggestions: add loading and empty states for the data query.

output_examples.input: Check this MERN repository for high-risk architecture problems.
output: Project Health: large service files detected and tests are missing for payment flows.
Critical: deployment should wait until payment tests cover failure paths.
Important: service layer mixes database writes, validation, and response formatting.
Verdict: needs focused refactoring and test coverage before production use.

best_practices: Share the intended review scope and any deployment deadline before using the skill.
Approve local commands explicitly when reviewing an untrusted repository.
Review Critical findings first, then confirm Important findings with tests or reproduction steps.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a replacement for automated tests, dependency scanners, or manual security review.
Do not run suggested shell commands against untrusted code without sandboxing or approval.
Do not paste secret values into prompts or final review output.

faq.question: What projects is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for MERN applications that use MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, and related TypeScript or JavaScript tooling.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance, but any command should be approved by the user and handled by the active AI tool.

faq.question: Can it review a single file?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports single-file reviews and applies the relevant checklist to that file.

faq.question: Can it review an entire repository?
faq.answer: Yes. It starts with project health, then samples key files and focuses on high-risk areas.

faq.question: Does it cover security issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes MERN security checks for auth, secrets, CORS, XSS, NoSQL injection, file uploads, and dependency risk.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the review scope, changed files, known risks, test status, and any release or deployment constraints.
